name: httpbin-submit
description: Fill httpbin form, submit, and verify echoed JSON contains our values.

phases.name: fill
phases.verify_script: const v = await h.eval("({n:document.querySelector('input[name=custname]').value,t:document.querySelector('input[name=custtel]').value,e:document.querySelector('input[name=custemail]').value,c:document.querySelector('textarea[name=comments]').value})"); const ok = v.n===ARGS.custname && v.t===ARGS.custtel && v.e===ARGS.custemail && v.c===ARGS.comments; return {ok, why: ok ? '' : 'fill mismatch: '+JSON.stringify(v)};

phases.name: submit
phases.reflex_script: await h.click('form[action="/post"] button', {tries: 3, gap: 300}); return {ok: true};
phases.verify_script: const txt = await h.eval('document.body.innerText'); let j=null; try{j=JSON.parse(txt);}catch(e){} const ok = !!j && !!j.form && j.form.custname===ARGS.custname && j.form.custemail===ARGS.custemail && j.form.comments===ARGS.comments; return {ok, why: ok ? '' : 'echoed JSON missing values'};

phases.name: verify-echo
phases.verify_script: const txt = await h.eval('document.body.innerText'); let j=null; try{j=JSON.parse(txt);}catch(e){ return {ok:false, why:'not json'}; } const f=j.form||{}; const ok = f.custname===ARGS.custname && f.custtel===ARGS.custtel && f.custemail===ARGS.custemail && f.comments===ARGS.comments; return {ok, why: ok ? '' : 'missing values in '+JSON.stringify(f)};
